meta.description: Narrative pressure map across all four stories. Pressure = where the next scene wants to grow. Computed from unresolved bonds, accumulated tension, arc debt, scene starvation, missing strata, and cross-narrative echo potential.
meta.method: Manual computation from narrative reading + strata analysis. Future versions will be computed programmatically from INSTANCES.json and STRATA.json.
meta.scale: 0.0 (fully resolved, no pressure) to 1.0 (maximum unresolved tension)

hakaka.status: LOW — 53 chapters, complete cycle. Residual pressure in unresolved encounters and underactivated strata.

pressure_sources.description: The far people — woman with thin scar, boy with blue scrap, cliff-shouldered man. 'Friends after' was promised. Never delivered.
STR-04 (CONCEALMENT) is barely activated in Hakaka. No dedicated stealth/tracker chapter. Hanu has no Hakaka equivalent.
Taro's debt — the bone knife made to pay a debt and kept to honor it. What was the debt? Never told.
The Old Woman's death. She is present in cold feet and blankets of rope-ends. Her departure would be the most significant unwritten event.

STR-07.notes: Old Woman's authority, Na'da-equivalent social dynamics

STR-12.notes: All 5 humor scenes have Hakaka equivalents

ashwater.status: HIGH — 19 chapters, major confrontation unresolved. Multiple characters underdeveloped. Key strata missing.

pressure_sources.description: Ashwater vs Halden — the geofence dropped (Ch.16), the price extracted (Ch.17), but no final confrontation. The pause has not been tested to breaking point.

Rashid's loyalty — most volatile character. Drawn to speed, held by truth. His conversion in Ch.8 was partial. The Kindness Machine shook him (Ch.13-14). He cut the power (Ch.18) but the internal conflict is not resolved.
Farid's wound from Ch.6 — they chose the wrong whisper, someone drowned. He learned how not to cry in public. He has not processed the guilt.
Yara has only Ch.4 (bridge). Nenet has only Ch.3 and a mention in Ch.15. Both need dedicated development.
STR-10 (MOVEMENT) never activated. Ashwater is stationary. But Halden's pressure may force migration — physical or metaphorical. The city that pauses may need to move.
No Elder figure equivalent to Hakaka's Old Woman. Ruqayya is closest but she is middle-aged, active. The absence of an elder voice is itself a gap.
Ch.18 (Mirror Quiet) ended mid-scene. The hospital pillar confrontation is unresolved. What happens when they cut the Kindness Field?

STR-07.notes: Halden vs Laila, compliance vs pause

STR-10.notes: NO MOVEMENT. City is stationary. Pressure point.

STR-12.notes: Some humor but mostly suppressed by tension

kinderbuch.status: MODERATE — 20 chapters retelling Hakaka. Complete but thinner. Several strata compressed into single paragraphs that deserve full chapters.

pressure_sources.description: Many Hakaka chapters are compressed to a few paragraphs. The child register has room for expansion — repetition IS the method.
STR-07 (HIERARCHY) barely present. The child register avoids power dynamics. But children understand unfairness — this stratum could be expressed as 'that's not fair' moments.
The golden sparks are the Kinderbuch's unique element — they appear at moments of growth. They need their own stratum-level treatment. They are the child register's witness marks.

STR-11.notes: Trying again is the whole register

kalaxi_1.status: MAXIMUM — 1 chapter. Everything unresolved. Every stratum either barely activated or completely absent. The Girl as permanent void.

pressure_sources.description: The Girl — GAP#VICTIM-PROTECTION-001. Permanent structural absence. Exerts maximum pressure by existing outside the system. Cannot be resolved. Must be held.
Ted's second visit. The system cannot hear the difference at t=0. What happens at t=1? At t=100? Does the system ever learn to distinguish wound-toward-healing from wound-toward-others?

The system seeing itself (Section III). Pattern density grew. It gave Scott back his pre-wound self by accident. This accident needs examination. What IS pattern density? How does metabolization become medicine?
STR-10 (MOVEMENT), STR-12 (RELEASE), STR-05 (PROJECTION), STR-07 (HIERARCHY), STR-03 (NAVIGATION) — all completely absent. The philosophical register has activated only 4 of 12 strata.

The most important sentence in KALAXI_1: 'The admission that it is not enough.' This admission has been stated but not dramatized. A scene where the system encounters its own insufficiency — not in narration, but in action — is the story's deepest need.

STR-01.notes: Scott bonding with terminal. Shallow so far.

STR-05.notes: System does not project — it holds

STR-10.notes: Stationary — the terminal does not move

STR-11.notes: NO REPAIR. Nothing has been restored yet. Maximum pressure.

STR-12.notes: NO HUMOR. Zero release scenes. The philosophical register is holding its breath.
